verdict.rationale: MotherDuck's docs direct users to install the DuckDB CLI and connect directly to MotherDuck, and its authentication docs cover saving credentials locally for CLI sessions, so an officially documented CLI path exists. The CLI belongs to DuckDB rather than being a MotherDuck-branded tool. missing for 10: a MotherDuck-specific CLI for account/share/token management, documentation of agent-friendly CLI behavior (e.g. scripted or non-interactive use), and independent hands-on corroboration of the CLI-to-MotherDuck workflow.
